rationale: Although the stock remains near intraday lows, it is stalling precisely at the whole-dollar $39.00 support level while the broader market has staged a sharp recovery since entry (SPY rebounding from -1.42% to -0.69% and VIXY pulling back from +8.68% to +4.66%).
